remarks: Bright, spacious one-bedroom condo with balcony, ideally situated on Glenbrook Road, just minutes from vibrant Downtown Stamford, Metro-North, and I-95 for effortless commuting. This move-in ready unit features new kitchen appliances (refrigerator, dishwasher, oven range, and microwave), and fresh paint throughout, offering a clean, modern feel from the moment you step inside. The open layout provides comfortable living and dining space, complemented by a generously-sized closet located just outside the bedroom, providing additional storage. Bathroom has a new vanity. One assigned parking space (#38) is available for $25/month. Heat and hot water are included in the monthly HOA, adding value and convenience to this low-maintenance home. Laundry rooms (floors 2-9) have new washers & dryers. Recently installed intercom system w/video feature. On-site Superintendent. No rental restrictions and no pets. Living room bookcases included in sale or can be removed. Please note that there is a 10-day right of first refusal, triggered by an accepted offer, per the Crosswinds Condominium Association By-Laws.
